name: Executable Operating Documentation
summary: Derive operator guidance and documentation from canonical warning semantics, a versioned data dictionary and executable examples, with CI rejecting drift.
problem: Dashboards and runbooks can disagree about warnings, units, ownership and recovery, making unknown evidence appear healthy or automatic work appear manual.
coreOutcomes: Canonical warning meanings and safe inspection actions
Versioned field types, units and unavailable semantics
Shared UI, CLI and generated documentation
Executable examples, drift checks and projection budgets
boundaries: Copying an inspection command is not execution
Optional disabled features are not automatically broken
Dashboard caching cannot authorise consequential work
